description: The image is of a white t-shirt with a colorful floral design on the front. The design features a variety of colorful flowers and leaves in different shades of pink, orange, yellow, blue, and purple. The flowers are arranged in a symmetrical pattern, with some overlapping each other. The leaves are green and have a leafy texture. The shirt has a round neckline and short sleeves. The brand name "EA7" is printed in black on the top left corner of the shirt. The background is plain white.
